page.overview:
Who is Ezhar II?

Emperor Ezhar II was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1145–1188 AG), succeeding the regent Yahya bin Isa as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Ezhar was a cousin of Emperor Josif I.

Ezhar was succeeded in 1188 by his son Istaivan I.
